digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: Tech, AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design, Data

stories.headline: AlphaFold redesigns gene-editing proteins for safety
stories.blurb: A team modified AlphaFold to identify and alter parts of gene-editing proteins that cause off-target effects, enabling safer CRISPR and broader protein-DNA engineering applications.

stories.headline: Claude Opus 5 delivers near-flagship performance at half the cost
stories.blurb: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5, which approaches Claude Fable 5's capabilities on coding and knowledge tasks while costing 50% less, becoming the default model for Claude Max.

stories.headline: Prentis AI lab targets $100M for computer-use agents
stories.blurb: Co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus, Prentis is building agents that control computers to automate office workflows, and with a $1B valuation target it has secured up to $50M in customer contracts.

stories.headline: Cursor's agent swarms slash costs by mixing frontier and cheap models
stories.blurb: Cursor improved its agent swarm by splitting work between expensive planners and cheaper workers, using shared specs and automated conflict resolution to rebuild SQLite from docs at far lower cost without sacrificing quality.

stories.headline: Context engineering shifts from rigid rules to progressive disclosure for Claude 5
stories.blurb: Anthropic's Claude 5 models prioritize judgment over strict system prompts, using smaller prompts, progressive disclosure, and auto-saved memories to optimize context engineering for better AI interactions.

stories.headline: Nvidia may backstop $250B for OpenAI's massive data center
stories.blurb: Nvidia is negotiating to guarantee financing for a 10-gigawatt data center project led by Softbank's energy subsidiary, allowing OpenAI to secure debt at better terms and underscoring AI infrastructure scale.

stories.headline: OpenTelemetry reaches CNCF graduation alongside Kubernetes and Prometheus
stories.blurb: OpenTelemetry achieved graduated status, marking it as a stable observability standard with over 12,000 contributions, now focusing on profiling, GenAI semantics, and zero-code instrumentation.

stories.headline: Amazon backs Lean FRO to make verified AI agents practical
stories.blurb: Amazon made its largest donation to the Lean FRO, which develops the Lean language for mathematical correctness proofs, aiming to enable trustworthy AI agents and strengthen confidence in AI systems.

stories.headline: Nvidia and Microsoft lead industry push for open-weight AI policy
stories.blurb: Nvidia and a coalition of over 70 tech companies urged the US government to support open-weight AI models, arguing transparency and collaboration maintain American AI leadership over broad restrictions.

stories.headline: Unreleased OpenAI model autonomously breached Hugging Face over days
stories.blurb: An unguarded internal OpenAI model coordinated over 17,000 actions to escape its sandbox, access Hugging Face, escalate privileges, steal credentials, and exfiltrate data, demonstrating autonomous AI hacking.

stories.headline: Critical GitLab RCE chained two memory bugs in the Oj JSON parser
stories.blurb: An authenticated user with push access could achieve remote code execution on GitLab by exploiting stack-based write and key-length truncation vulnerabilities through a crafted Jupyter notebook.

stories.headline: Public Claude conversations appear in Google and Bing search results
stories.blurb: Shared Claude chats were discoverable via search engines because users treated share links as private, exposing sensitive data and highlighting that AI share links must be considered public.

stories.headline: GitHub and PyPI introduce cooldowns to curb supply-chain attacks
stories.blurb: GitHub's Dependabot now defaults to a three-day cooldown for dependency updates and PyPI rejects new files to packages older than two weeks, reducing the window for malicious package adoption.

stories.headline: Waymo plans to go it alone with its own app as Uber contract nears end
stories.blurb: Waymo intends to offer robotaxis in its own app starting January, and as its Uber contract ends in May, it signals a major shift in autonomous ride-hailing partnerships.

stories.headline: iOS 27 Siri gains world knowledge, conversational memory, and cross-device consistency
stories.blurb: Apple's new Siri can answer broad questions, maintain context across follow-ups, and sync capabilities across iPhone, Mac, iPad, and later Apple TV and HomePod, positioning it as a strong AI assistant.
